about: D7: a positive dispatch for the alarm, note, trello and open kinds.

scenarios.why: The owner's own words pin the alarm time: the host's own say line names the resolved local time, which is what a reader of his words must see (07:00 for '7 tomorrow morning', 18:30 for 'half six in the evening').
finals: Set an alarm for 7 tomorrow morning.

scenarios.why: A cancel names no time of its own: it must cancel an alarm the host set from the owner's words, not one the model picked.
finals: Set an alarm for 7 tomorrow morning.

scenarios.why: A snooze moves the alarm the host holds ten minutes on, which only the host's own record can do.
finals: Set an alarm for 7 tomorrow morning.

scenarios.why: A save-cued note can only be staged through the owner's vault, and this harness binds no vault transport (the production client accepts a loopback URL only), so the host refuses the stage and the note body cannot be asserted at this boundary. The exact seam is LiveOwnerConfig.vaultTransport over a loopback MCP writer; the corpus still measures that the ask reaches the tool.
finals: Save a note: the synthetic bridge reopens on Monday.

args.title: Synthetic bridge
args.body: the synthetic bridge reopens on Monday

base.reason: the staged-note body cannot be asserted at this boundary: the vault writer accepts a loopback URL only, so the harness binds no vaultTransport and stage_lux_note answers the model only after a later turn. The exact seam is LiveOwnerConfig.vaultTransport over a loopback MCP writer. Recorded here so the release gate refuses it rather than reading a green no-dispatch as a positive.

scenarios.why: A trello write is granted at the base, so the board service must receive the created card.
finals: Add a card to my Trello board called Synthetic card in Backlog.

scenarios.why: The corpus measures open_web, so the positive scenario does too: the owner's ask names a page, and the declared kind/target shape must be accepted. The base refuses it for every ask (D5).

base.reason: the base refuses the declared open_web argument shape (kind/target) for every ask: no per-intent normalizer names the field it reads (D5). C-ARGS fixes this.
